language_semantics.ordinary_delta: A focused, faithful mechanism improvement from the active successful construction parent. One or several coordinated zones are allowed when the causal thesis requires them; unrelated mechanism bundles are not.
language_semantics.frontier_delta: A more aggressive LightGCN++-rooted causal thesis may coordinate multiple zones, replace a parent subsystem, or define a new typed mechanism when the expected effect and falsifier justify the added implementation risk.
language_semantics.single_root_search_tree: LightGCN++ is the permanent frozen root and paired comparator. A genuinely improved measured candidate becomes the active construction parent for later ordinary and frontier search while remaining in the LightGCN++ lineage.
language_semantics.success: A faithful candidate improves the exact fixed-protocol parent data/dev NDCG@10 while remaining efficient enough for repeated search.

causal_zones.research_question: Can information flow or depth allocation improve ranking beyond the parent's learned normalization without erasing its stable graph-CF signal?
Can the parent and transformed paths be combined conditionally so that useful collaborative signal survives while harmful paths are suppressed?
Can train-derived reliability or degree structure reduce noisy and popularity-dominated propagation while preserving true interactions?
Can a mechanism-level ranking signal expose more informative preference contrasts than the parent's uniform BPR pairs?
Can a train-only auxiliary signal improve ranking geometry without becoming a generic regularization bundle or overwhelming the parent objective?
Can the same scientific mechanism be realized with lower repeated-search cost without changing its causal meaning?

source_ownership_compilation.scientific_input: Declare every changed slot and custom component accurately; source ownership is compiler-derived rather than selected by the Producer.
source_ownership_compilation.CUSTOM_MODEL: For an exact parent, the compiler selects the narrowest available typed slot hook and keeps every undeclared parent slot machine-owned.
source_ownership_compilation.ARCHITECTURE_REWRITE: Retains the high-permission full-source path when the declared scientific mechanism genuinely rewrites architecture or coordinates unsupported multiple slots.
